meta.title: Claimant count by LSOA (latest month) with LA trend
meta.publisher: Office for National Statistics / DWP (via Nomis)
meta.geography: LSOA21 (latest month); LA, region, England, county (24 months)
meta.next_update: Monthly with the ONS labour market release (mid-month)
meta.quality: Official statistics (experimental status removed); administrative count of people claiming JSA or UC with a 'searching for work' requirement on the count date. Rates here are recomputed by this pipeline using ONS small-area population (mid-2024), not Nomis's own 16-64 proportion.
meta.limitations: Counts are rounded to the nearest 5 at LSOA level (small cells 0/5 are highly uncertain); LA rows are the published LA figures, and LSOA sums do not equal them. Under Universal Credit the count includes some people in low-paid work required to seek more work, so it is not a pure unemployment measure and rose structurally with UC rollout; it excludes inactive people (e.g. LT sick on UC health) who are not searching for work. Population denominators lag the claimant month by up to two years. 50+ claimants have no matched denominator (rate omitted).
